Objectives Resolution

1.1.1
Shri Jawaharlal Nehru

Mr. President, I beg to move the following Objectives Resolution. This resolution sets out the fundamental principles upon which our Constitution is to be built. India is to be an independent sovereign republic.

1.1.2
Dr. B.R. Ambedkar

Mr. President, I rise to support the Objectives Resolution moved by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru. We must ensure that equality of status and of opportunity shall be assured to all citizens.

The Question of Procedure

1.1.3
Shri T.T. Krishnamachari

Mr. President, I also support the Objectives Resolution. The resolution before us is a statement of aims and aspirations of the people of India.
